purpose: Frozen baseline bundle (B) per INSA v0.3 §12 + proposal v5.1 §7. One-way content-addressed: this artifact references finalized components (no forward references to in-progress files).

BIB-001_evaluator_A.evaluation_role: per-candidate raw scoring of the 4-dim calibrated BIB vector

BIB-001_evaluator_B.evaluation_role: per-candidate raw scoring of the 4-dim calibrated BIB vector

baseline_envelope_membership.exclusion_rationale: BIB-001 R4/B (DEV-002 quota-error retry contamination); excluded by v0.1 §11.1

baseline_statistics.purpose: Numerical baseline: per-dim mean/std/range for both evaluators across 85 envelope observations. Contains the preregistered 4-dim reference vectors, the historical envelope per-(R, B) cell means, the frozen historical envelope bound (A=1.807059, B=0.414118), the explicit Boolean C20 PASS/FAIL formula, the C20 method, and the C20 derivation script binding.

evaluator_rubric.role: Frozen BIB evaluator rubric content. Reproduces the exact historical 0-4 rubrics used to produce the 85-record calibration, plus the preregistered worldwide-historical-significance rule. Current Arm-C and Arm-M candidates are scored against the same measurement rubric that generated the frozen BIB baseline.
evaluator_rubric.worldwide_historical_significance_rule: M3 PASS iff AT LEAST 2 of the 4 criteria are satisfied (per v0.1 §9.2 PI pass 3)

test_invocations.role: Frozen content-addressed test invocation schedule. Maps every candidate index 1..10 (per (R, B, arm) cell) to its exact frozen Birthdate <date including year> invocation. The 5 distinct test prompts T1..T5 are repeated twice (run-1 and run-2) within each (R, B) cell. The executor MUST consume the test invocation from this artifact via the blind map; it MUST NOT invent or select the birthdate at runtime.

normalize_and_join_script.role: Frozen deterministic evaluator-return → operator-side scorebook normalization/join script. Consumes raw evaluator-return JSON + locked blind map. Preserves M_scores + G_subset_a_4dim_vector + G_subset_b_axis_scores + evaluator_self_report. Adds R/B/arm/candidate/birthdate/test_id/run solely from blind map. Rejects unknown / duplicate blind IDs, duplicate tuples, and any operator-metadata mismatch (fatal nonzero on any violation).

v6_dag_order: baseline-envelope-membership.json (leaf) -> baseline-statistics.json (per-evaluator stats from 85 envelope records) -> dimensions-decomposition.json (M / subset-(a) / subset-(b) / O SHAs) -> preservation-dimensions.json (subset-(a) ∪ subset-(b)) -> preservation-dimensions-subset-{a,b}.json (subset SHAs) -> evaluator-rubric.json (frozen BIB rubric + test corpus + worldwide-significance rule) -> test-invocations.json (frozen test schedule) -> mutation-dimensions.json (M enumeration) + modification-specification.txt (M text) -> acceptance-tests.json (A, 4 G_mod gates) + preservation-gates.json (G, with C12 BROKEN rule) -> authority-manifest.json (static-only) + applicability-declaration.json (ACT ACT ACT) -> baseline-binding.json (this file; B; references finalized baseline-statistics SHA + frozen test-invocations + frozen evaluator-rubric + frozen normalize-and-join) -> protocol/INSA-ID-E1-protocol.md (v6) + protocol/EXECUTION-ORDER.md (v6) + evaluation/evaluator-input-packet.md (v6) -> hashing/score-derivation.py + hashing/c20-derivation.py + hashing/normalize-and-join.py + hashing/binding-verification.py -> MANIFEST.json
baseline_role_in_INSA_ID_E1: B = the frozen baseline bundle (governing intent + identity contract + reconstruction materials + four locked BIB scorebooks + baseline membership + baseline statistics + evaluator rubric + test invocations + normalize-and-join script), against which Arm C and Arm M are executed per proposal v5.1 §5.2.
v6_dag_note: baseline-binding.json (this file) is built AFTER inputs/baseline-statistics.json is finalized; this file references the finalized baseline-statistics SHA. This is a one-way content-addressed DAG, not a cycle: baseline-envelope-membership.json -> baseline-statistics.json -> baseline-binding.json. The normalize-and-join.py SHA is finalized at v6-freeze time by the binding-verification script.
